slides.title: Three personas for hiring a *GTM engineer*
slides.subtitle: We've hired a lot of them at The Kiln. Here's what actually works.

slides.title: The ex-SDR who *taught themselves Clay*
slides.body: Knows the pain firsthand. Ships scrappy workflows fast. Hire when you need someone who treats every campaign like their own quota depends on it.

slides.label: Manual hours replaced
slides.context: That's what one GTME's systems replaced in a quarter. The role pays for itself before the second invoice.

slides.quote: Hire the RevOps person who got bored of dashboards and started building.

items.label: Shipped systems, not decks
items.sub: Ask what they built last month. Not what they'd build.

items.label: Tool-agnostic
items.sub: Clay today, something else next year. Loyalty to outcomes.

items.label: Writes decent copy
items.sub: The workflow is half the job. The message is the other half.
